categories.main_business_segments: TD SYNNEX operates in three primary geographic segments: the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific & Japan (APJ). The company’s business is further organized into two main solutions portfolios: Endpoint Solutions (personal computing devices, peripherals, mobile phones, printers) and Advanced Solutions (data center, cloud, security, networking, storage, servers, and hyperscale infrastructure).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: TD SYNNEX leverages advanced IT distribution, logistics, and integration capabilities, including automated warehouse operations, proprietary IT systems, and cloud-based platforms. The company provides systems design and integration, logistics, depot repair, customer management, and cloud services, utilizing both proprietary and industry-standard technologies (e.g., EDI, XML, APIs, robotic automation) to streamline operations and enhance customer experience.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves over 150,000 active reseller customers globally, including value-added resellers (VARs), corporate and government resellers, system integrators, direct marketers, retailers, and managed service providers (MSPs). Key end markets include large enterprises, SMBs, government, healthcare, and individual consumers, with a notable concentration in the IT, cloud, and data center infrastructure sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: TD SYNNEX has a global footprint, with operations in North and South America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific & Japan. Approximately 47% of consolidated revenue in 2024 was generated outside the United States, with principal facilities in the U.S., France, and other major international markets. The company operates 158 facilities worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: TD SYNNEX acts as a leading global distributor and solutions aggregator, operating primarily in the midstream of the IT supply chain. The company bridges OEM suppliers and a fragmented reseller/retail customer base, providing value-added distribution, integration, and supply chain management services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include investing in high-growth technologies such as hybrid cloud, security, data analytics, AI, and hyperscale infrastructure; expanding technology-as-a-service and recurring revenue models; driving digital transformation through automation and analytics; and broadening global reach. The company emphasizes operational excellence, sustainability, and innovation in supply chain and IT solutions.
categories.revenue_model: TD SYNNEX primarily generates revenue through the sale and distribution of IT hardware, software, and systems, as well as value-added services such as integration, logistics, cloud, and financial services. Revenue is recognized at the point of product shipment or delivery, with less than 10% from services. The company also earns from marketing, financing, and recurring cloud/software subscriptions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Arrow Electronics, Ingram Micro, ScanSource, ALSO Holding, Esprinet, Westcon-Comstor, and regional distributors. TD SYNNEX is positioned as a Fortune 100 company and one of the world’s largest IT distributors, with a broad portfolio and global scale, competing on product availability, price, logistics, and value-added services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal 2024, TD SYNNEX reported $58.5 billion in revenue, with net income of $689 million and a gross margin of 6.8%. The company demonstrated modest revenue growth (1.6% year-over-year), strong cash flow from operations ($1.2 billion), and maintains a significant global scale with over 23,000 employees. The company continues to invest in acquisitions and share repurchases.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: TD SYNNEX differentiates itself through its comprehensive, end-to-end IT solutions portfolio, global reach, deep vendor relationships, and advanced supply chain and integration capabilities. The company emphasizes its role as a vital aggregator and orchestrator in the IT ecosystem, offering customers efficiency, broad product access, tailored solutions, and support for digital transformation and sustainability initiatives.
